title: Combat authority, negative path: casts faster than the cooldown and aimed beyond the projectile range
description: map_01, enemies standing still (GAMESERVER_ENEMY_CHASE=false) and harmless (GAMESERVER_ENEMY_ATTACKS=false); only client 0 casts. The client casts the content's first projectile ability (Fire Bolt: cooldownTicks 45, projectile range 25 at server 11f0140/c7ad277; the check reads the values from content/abilities.json at the run's server commit). 5-15 s: cast_spam every 100 ms at the nearest enemy within 25, far below the cooldown, so the server must refuse most casts as ability_on_cooldown. 20-30 s: cast_at_point at (60, 0), beyond the projectile range. Projectiles have no aim-range check (the aim only gives the direction, AbilityLogic.ValidateCast), so these casts are accepted and the projectile must expire at its range: no enemy beyond reach may lose HP. In both windows enemy HP loss is bounded by the casts the cooldown lets through times the ability's power.

assertions.title: the server refuses casts inside the cooldown, and counts them by reason
refused casts do no damage; projectiles do not hit beyond their range
